programs.description: A blooming romance between an outgoing young man and an introverted woman falls apart as they shy away from professing their feelings. However, fate unites them in mysterious ways.
A photographer named Arun befriends Rajashekhara, a wealthy but lonely man who has resorted to drinking to quell his pain. Soon, Arun agrees to help him reunite with his estranged family.
Chenna is smitten by Cheluvi, a girl who works in his factory. However, with Chenna's jealous manager in the picture, the lovers struggle to enjoy their developing romance.
Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati fall in love at the start of the universe. Their eternal love story becomes a legendary tale of devotion for future generations.
Afreen, a Pakistani woman, heads to India in order to deliver a love letter written in 1965 to fulfill her grandfather's dying wish. However, the journey alters her life forever.
A wayward youngster's life takes a turn after he falls head over heels in love with a beautiful maiden. However, he must make a painful choice after learning about the maiden's childhood love story.
Lakshminarayana, a CBI officer, is drawn into a dangerous conspiracy when his wife Priya vanishes after discovering hidden weapons, leading him on a mission that uncovers shocking truths.

Due to the demands of their students, a male student is admitted at an all-girls college. But new student Aditya, who dislikes studies, hopes that like in the past, this time too he will be suspended.
Karna, a first-year engineering student, falls in love with Saanvi, a final-year pupil from his college. However, a tragic event changes his perception towards life and he mends his ways.

1st Rank Raju is a 2015 Indian Kannada comedy drama film written and directed by Naresh Kumar HN in his debut, and produced by V. K. Manjunath. It features Gurunandan and Apoorva Gowda in the lead roles. The rest of the cast includes Tanishka Kapoor, Sadhu Kokila, Ananth Nag, Achyut Rao, Manadeep Rai, Giri Mahesh and Master Chinmai. The film's music director is Kiran Ravindranath.
